title: She'd lost her first Super Series final the year before. This time, she didn't let it slip.

sources.text: BWF Badminton - 'Great Wall' Breached: Thaihot China Open 2016 Finals
Business Standard - Sindhu wins China Open final

caption:
She'd lost her first Super Series final the year before. This time, she didn't let it slip.

Sindhu won 21-11, 17-21, 21-11 in Fuzhou - the top tier of the BWF Super Series circuit at the time and a bigger title than the Denmark Open final she'd lost the year before.

Sindhu had already won Olympic silver at Rio 2016 just months earlier. The China Open title showed that result wasn't a one-off - it was the start of a run that would eventually include a World Championship gold.

Sindhu's China Open win is one data point in a longer pattern - Indian badminton's rise from occasional upsets to a program that expects to win at the top level.
